The Reagentry is in the southern portion of the House of Rituals and where the ingredients for the rituals of the house are kept, managed by Jor'dan the Powerful. Various beasts are kept for their parts, such as spore clusters from blightrays for ritual incense, or beasts are taken from other realms, such as veilwings for their hearts.

The Razorwing Nest is found at on the western edge of the Windswept Aerie of southwestern Korthia. Guarded by the friendly Dusklight Matriarch hovering above, she is looking for the Lost Razorwing Egg. Kill devourers until it drops and return the egg for a reward of 3% progress toward Shaping Fate. : After doing this enough times, the Dusklight Matriarch awards the Dusklight Razorwing flying mount: :
Re-Powered Golliath Fists drop from Collector Astorestes in Bastion.
Razorwing mounts are flying mounts that were introduced in patch 9.1.0. All of them are usable by both Alliance and Horde characters.

A realm is an instance of the World of Warcraft (WoW) game world. Realms are hosted on physical devices called server blades (for this reason, the terms "realm" and "server" are often used interchangeably). This prevents any one realm from becoming too crowded and overwhelming its associated server, provides for better connection times by allowing players to connect to local servers, allows for localized communities based on language, and allows different play-styles for different groups of users. __NOTOC__ The Reanimated Abomination is created by using an Abomination Reanimation Kit upon Chilled Abomination Guts culled from a Hulking Abomination. It is created under the control of the user, as a pet. The user has the standard pet controls available to cause it to follow, stay, or attack; aggressive, defensive, or passive; and trigger use of its abilities. If you have an existing pet, dismiss it first or the guts will disappear without spawning a Reanimated Abomination.

The Recipe: Mok'Nathal Shortribs teaches you to make Mok'Nathal Shortribs. This recipe is a quest reward from completing Mok'Nathal Treats. Alliance can purchase this recipe from Sassa Weldwell the trade goods vendor at Toshley's Station in Blade's Edge Mountains. The recipe is Bind on Pickup. This recipe can be bought from Xerintha Ravenoak as a limited supply.

The Recipe: Major Mana Potion is sold for by Magnus Frostwake, who is found on the island of Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. It also drops from Darkmaster Gandling in Scholomance. In some cases, it may be favorable to create Unstable Mana Potion instead, which has the same effect, is learned from Alchemy trainers in Outland, uses cheaper herbs and provides a chance at discovering a new recipe.

__NOTOC__ This recipe for Westfall Stew is famous throughout Westfall, and everyone in Westfall knows it by name and recognizes it immediately. The recipe was created by Verna Furlbrow before she and her husband Theodore Furlbrow tried to leave Westfall for Stormwind City. When their wagon broke down, she asked a passing Alliance adventurer to deliver her recipe, which she quickly scribbled down, to Salma Saldean as a gift. Salma continued to make the stew, and eventually it became known as her recipe instead.

Region is a term used to designate the different areas in which World of Warcraft service is offered. The four current regions are Americas & Oceania (US & OCE), Europe (EU), Taiwan (TW), and Korea (KR). Game services were suspended in the China (CN) region on 23 January 2023 and it is unknown when, or if, they will return. World of Warcraft accounts are region-specific and only allow the use of features related to that region, including access to that region's selection of realms. For a list of realms by region, see realms list. Most account-bound features, such as achievements and collectibles, are region-specific. To regem is to apply new gems to a piece of equipment that already has gems socketed. There is no penalty for regemming equipment, except that the original gem in the socket cannot be extracted, only destroyed. You do not need a jewelcrafter to gem or regem gear. You can gem and regem gear anywhere in the world at any time (even in combat).

Reginald Arcfire is a pair of the steam-powered auctioneers (programmed with a superiority chip) with access to Horde Auction House. The original one can be found in Dalaran's Like Clockwork Engineering Shop, and his copy can be found in Sunreaver's Sanctuary. Original one can be seen by Horde players only and he previously interacted with Horde Grand Master engineers only.

Introduced to Azeroth by the Highborne, Reforging (also called thaumaturgy) allowed undesired stats on gear to be exchanged for more useful stats. It allowed 40% of a single secondary stat (such as critical strike, dodge, haste, hit or parry rating) or spirit to be exchanged for another secondary stat or spirit. Reforging was handled by NPCs known as Arcane Reforgers located in the major cities. The cost of reforging an item was equal to its sale value. Restoring an item to its original state was free. Stats could only be exchanged for other stats which are not already on the gear. Earlier in Cataclysm's development, reforging was planned to be an ability of Jewelcrafters, Engineers, Tailors

The Refuge of the Broken is a location in the Lower City of Shattrath. Its courtyard is frequented by Broken alcoholics who come to smoke and drink sour watered wine, and the air stinks of tobacco and sweat. Akama held several of his secret meetings with Maiev Shadowsong in a chamber in the Refuge. The last such meeting took place two months before the invasion of Outland, when he informed her of Kael'thas Sunstrider's abandonment of the Illidari and of Illidan's efforts to create an army of demon hunters.
